mainEntity.name: How long does railing repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of railing repair depends on the scope of the project. Simple repairs, such as replacing a few pickets, might take a few hours. More extensive repairs involving structural elements or multiple sections could take several days. We will provide a time estimate after assessing the damage during the initial inspection.
